name: Man'in Kairaku Densha ~In'yoku no Chikan Junkansen~
original_name: マン淫快楽電車 ～淫欲の痴姦循環線～
source:
Sanae Asai rides the commuter train to school for the first time.
Her heart is filled with anxiety and apprehension of the unknown...
She should have listened to her gut feeling...

[Edited from DLsite English]
translation:
浅井早苗第一次乘坐通勤电车去学校。
面对未知，她心中满是不安与忐忑……
她本该相信自己的直觉……

[编译自DLsite英文版]
